blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The government’s antipoverty czar Secretary Manny Pacquiao will also get his own honorary doctorate degree. The Philippine Normal University (PNU) said the boxing champ will receive the Doctor in Physical Education and Sports, honoris causa, during a ceremony on Wednesday.
